title: ANTHROPIC IPO: Don't Buy Until You Watch This!
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: Anthropic's rumored ~$2T IPO valuation with ~$42B net loss is too expensive to invest in; only worth trading for momentum, likely like SpaceX: breakout then sharp correction.
30y Treasury above 5.56%, highest since 2003; the bond crisis keeps getting worse.
Markets are overbought and testing major support; a break would drag everything lower.

calls.condition: if QQQ breaks its major support range, expect retrace to ~700

calls.quote: if we do, then we'll most likely retrace back down to lows of 700 for QQQ.

calls.reason: Shorted overbought reversal after Iran sanctions-relief report was denied and BTC corrected; position closed same day.
